GET Accounts
NT8
Tradovate
Get list of all accounts NT8​

Lists the NinjaTrader accounts available to the authenticated CrossTrade user.

Endpoint​

GET /v1/api/accounts

Headers​
NAME	VALUE
Content-Type	application/json
Authorization	Bearer <token>
Code examples​
Python
JavaScript
cURL
import requests



token = 'my-secret-token'



url = "https://app.crosstrade.io/v1/api/accounts"

headers = {

    "Authorization": f"Bearer {token}",

    "Content-Type": "application/json"

}



try:

    response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)

    print(f"Response Code: {response.status_code}, Response Text: {response.text}")

except Exception as e:

    print(f"An error occurred: {e}")

Response​
200
400
401
408
429
500
{

    "accounts": [

        {

            "id": 2,

            "name": "Sim101",

            "status": "Enabled"

        }

    ],

    "success": true

}

Success field types​
FIELD	TYPE	DESCRIPTION
success	boolean	true on success.
accounts	array of objects	Available accounts; may be empty.
accounts[].id	integer	NT8 account identifier.
accounts[].name	string	Account name.
accounts[].status	string	Account status, such as Enabled.
Platform nuances​

The response returns the account list in accounts. Each documented NT8 account record contains id, name, and status.

WebSocket API​

This request can also be made over the WebSocket API.

{

  "action": "rpc",

  "id": "my-request-id",

  "api": "ListAccounts",

  "args": {}

}
